name: Chol'aruk the Ravener
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
There's rumors of a monstrous abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say its so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me it's head.
narrative.objectives: Bring Chol'aruk's Head to Bainham in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText: My dead men will rest easier knowing that there is one less of these monsters in the world. You've done well, and are a true and stalwart defender of the alliance. Thank you.Go with honor, Gryma.
narrative.requestItemsText: It took six of us to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to kill all but myself and one other before we were able to bring it down.This far from alliance lands I should leave it well enough alone. Light knows I'll lose little sleep over a few tauren savages or orcish brutes. However, the honor of my fallen brothers demands action.
